body: Hello, I just joined this server from Overcast Network and decided to introduce myself. I mainly play defensive positions but I just came off of a fairly long hiatus from Minecraft so I may not be at the level I used to be. For those wondering, I came up with the name above by generating a random string. If you guys have any questions about me, feel free to ask. I look forward to playing on this server and maybe even contributing.
